blocks.prompt: 14 Find the general solution of the differential equation \((y^2 + 2xy)\,dx + x^2\,dy = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Pehle degrees dekhte hain: \(y^2\), \(2xy\) aur \(x^2\), teeno ki degree 2 hai (\(xy\) mein \(1 + 1 = 2\)).
Jab \(dx\) aur \(dy\) ke coefficients ki har term ki degree barabar ho to equation homogeneous hoti hai.
Diya kya hai? \((y^2 + 2xy)\,dx + x^2\,dy = 0\). Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Rule kaunsa? \(y = vx\) wala tareeqa; beech mein partial fractions bhi lagenge kyunke \(v\) ki taraf \(\frac{1}{v(v+3)}\) aayega.
Plan: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) nikalna, \(y = vx\) rakhna, variables alag karna, partial fractions, integrate, phir \(v\) wapas.
steps:
Diya gaya: \((y^2 + 2xy)\,dx + x^2\,dy = 0\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Homogeneous equation (har term degree 2): \(y = vx\), \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\). Yeh substitution equation ko separable bana deta hai.

\(\frac{dy}{dx} = F(y/x)\) ki shakal mein likhein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -\dfrac{y^2 + 2xy}{x^2}\]
\[= -\left(\dfrac{y^2}{x^2} + \dfrac{2y}{x}\right)\]
Kyun: \(x^2\,dy\) ko ek taraf rakh kar \(x^2\,dx\) se divide kiya. Phir har term ko \(x^2\) se alag alag divide kiya to sirf \(y/x\) bacha. Yeh is baat ka saboot hai ke equation waqai homogeneous hai.
Dhyan dein: Minus ka sign poori bracket par hai; isay bhool jana is sawal ki sab se aam ghalti hai.

\(y = vx\) rakhein
\[v + x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = -(v^2 + 2v)\]
\[x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = -v^2 - 3v\]
\[x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = -v(v + 3)\]
Kyun: Left wala \(v\) right side par minus ho kar gaya: \(-v^2 - 2v - v = -v^2 - 3v\). Phir \(-v\) common nikala taa ke agle qadam mein factors saaf nazar aayein.

Variables alag karein
\[\dfrac{dv}{v(v + 3)} = -\dfrac{dx}{x}\]
Kyun: \(v\) wala hissa \(dv\) ke saath, \(x\) wala hissa \(dx\) ke saath. Is ke liye \(v(v+3)\) se divide kiya (yeh maan kar ke \(v \neq 0\) aur \(v \neq -3\)).

Partial fractions
\[\dfrac{1}{v(v + 3)} = \dfrac{1}{3}\left(\dfrac{1}{v} - \dfrac{1}{v + 3}\right)\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{v(v+3)}\) ka integral seedha yaad nahi, lekin \(\frac{1}{v}\) aur \(\frac{1}{v+3}\) ke integrals log hain. Tasdeeq: \(\frac{1}{v} - \frac{1}{v+3} = \frac{(v+3) - v}{v(v+3)} = \frac{3}{v(v+3)}\), is liye aage \(\frac{1}{3}\) lagana para.

Integrate karein
\[\tfrac{1}{3}\left(\ln|v| - \ln|v + 3|\right)\]
\[= -\ln|x| + \ln|c|\]
\[\ln\left|\dfrac{v}{v + 3}\right| = \ln\left|\dfrac{c^3}{x^3}\right|\]
\[\dfrac{v}{v + 3} = \dfrac{C}{x^3}\]
Kyun: Pehle dono taraf 3 se multiply kiya. Phir log ke rules: \(\ln a - \ln b = \ln\frac{a}{b}\) aur \(3\ln a = \ln a^3\). Jab dono taraf sirf ek ek log ho to log hata sakte hain. \(\pm c^3\) ko naya constant \(C\) likh diya, kyunke constant ki shakal se farq nahi parta.

\(v = y/x\) wapas rakhein
\[\dfrac{v}{v + 3} = \dfrac{y/x}{(y + 3x)/x} = \dfrac{y}{y + 3x}\]
\[\dfrac{y}{y + 3x} = \dfrac{C}{x^3}\]
\[x^3 y = C(y + 3x)\]
Kyun: \(v + 3 = \frac{y}{x} + 3 = \frac{y + 3x}{x}\). Upar neeche ke \(x\) cancel ho gaye. Aakhir mein cross-multiply kiya taa ke fraction khatam ho jaye.

Tasdeeq
\(x^3y = C(y + 3x)\) ko differentiate karein: \(3x^2y + x^3y' = C(y' + 3)\). Phir \(C = \frac{x^3y}{y + 3x}\) rakh kar simplify karein:
\[x^2 y' = -(y^2 + 2xy)\]
Yeh wohi di hui equation hai \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Jawab ko differentiate kar ke constant khatam kiya to asal equation wapas aa gayi; is ka matlab jawab sahi hai (computer algebra se bhi check kiya).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab number 16 par chhapa hai, 14 par nahi. Exercise 4.2 ki keys 2 se 29 tak hain jabke sawal sirf 25 hain (key 2 Question 1 ka jawab hai, aur keys 15, 19 aur 27 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi), is liye jawab 16 par dhoondiye, warna aap kisi aur sawal ka jawab dekh kar pareshan ho jayenge. Jawab khud, \(x^3y = C(y + 3x)\), sahi hai.
